findings.summary: fillna("unknown") also relabels orders whose customer exists but has a null region, which is broader than the docstring says (only missing customers).
validate="many_to_one" raises MergeError if customers has duplicate customer_id, so one bad customer row crashes the whole report.
fillna("unknown") raises TypeError if region is a categorical column without "unknown" as a category.
count skips null order_id values, so orders is undercounted if order_id can be null; size would count all rows.
sort_values on revenue_cents is not stable by default, so regions with tied revenue can appear in different order between runs.
